title: Make long titles wrap in a fixed-width grid
goal: limits the minimum size of the grid track to prevent long strings from breaking the layout.
summary: The English file name of a certain file has no spaces. The two file cards must be of equal width, and the file name must not overflow the card.
tasks: uses two tracks with a minimum width of 0 and a maximum of 1fr to maintain equal width.
allows in-place line wrapping of long strings within .document.

example.note: minmax(0, 1fr) Allows columns to be smaller than the inherent minimum size of the content. anywhere provides line breaking opportunities for long words.

hint: Adjust the properties that define column width; write the line breaking rules on the card.
